name: Hamburg
tagline: A harbour city of canals and concert halls
summary: Germany's great port city has more bridges than Venice, red-brick warehouses in the Speicherstadt and the soaring Elbphilharmonie concert hall. Its harbour, lakes and lively St. Pauli nightlife make it one of Europe's most underrated cities.
seasonNote: May to September is mildest. It's often grey and rainy. December brings Christmas markets, and the Hafengeburtstag harbour festival is in May.
arrival: Hamburg Airport is 25 minutes from the centre by S-Bahn. Trains from Berlin take under 2 hours.
gettingAround: U-Bahn, S-Bahn, buses and harbour ferries (lines 62 and 72) share one ticket.
cashTip: Cards are now widely accepted, but many bakeries, beer halls and small shops still prefer cash.
foodTip: Fischbrötchen (fish sandwiches), Franzbrötchen cinnamon pastries and Labskaus.
buyTip: Maritime goods, coffee and Hamburg design.
